name: Zro
description: Private inference for coding agents. Ranked #2 on Product Hunt July 16, 2026. Addresses privacy and security concerns in AI-powered coding workflows.

name: Grok Build
description: xAI's terminal-based AI coding agent CLI, open-sourced under Apache 2.0. Features 8 parallel subagents, plan-first workflow, Arena Mode, MCP support, and TUI interface written in Rust.

name: Aura
description: Open Source OSS IDE for controlling AI coding agents with built-in loops. Provides Agents + Git + Intent workflow for managing coding agents.

name: Android CLI
description: Agent-first toolkit for building Android apps directly from the terminal. Enables AI agents to create, build, and manage Android projects 3x faster with less guesswork.

name: TryCase
description: Disposable Linux test environments for AI coding agents. Enables agents to run applications, test changes end-to-end, capture screenshots/recordings, and return verified code safely.

name: Perfai Security
description: Autonomous security platform for AI-built apps (vibe-coded). Finds and fixes live vulnerabilities with a single prompt. Ranked #3 on Product Hunt July 9, 2026.

name: Constellation Gate
description: Security and audit gateway for AI applications with prompt injection defense (97.4% F1), token savings (20-40%), and on-chain audit trails. Ranked #1 in security benchmarks.

name: Coasty
description: Computer-Use-Agent that runs legacy software like a human. Enables AI agents to interact with legacy applications via secure cloud VMs without modernization.

name: Compendium
description: Company brain for teams working with AI agents. Centralized knowledge management where all agents share memory, knowledge, and context. Ranked #16 on Product Hunt July 8, 2026.

name: agents-cli
description: The CLI your coding agent uses to ship agents. Google's open-source command-line interface for creating AI agents from scaffolding to production deployment.

name: Brickken CLI
description: Terminal tool that enables AI agents to run on-chain blockchain workflows autonomously. Agents can register identities, pay via x402 in USDC, and deploy ERC-20 tokens directly from CLI.

name: Termi Protocol
description: 3D simulation environment for visualizing AI agent workflows. Gives coding agents a face, desk, and living room for monitoring agent activity.
